entities.name: Fahrettin Çiloğlu

entities.summary: Fahrettin Çiloğlu, is a Turkish writer and translator, whose family emigrated from Georgia in the late nineteenth century. In Georgian publications and Turkish translations, he uses the pen name ფარნა-ბექა ჩილაშვილი and Parna-Beka Çilaşvili.
